name: dark-goth-redhead-messy-bedroom-selfie
image_purpose: gothic outfit, room, and full-body mirror reference

prompt.project_info: Create a realistic full-body mirror selfie of an approved adult woman in a lived-in gothic bedroom.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with natural copper-red wavy hair, light blue-grey eyes, sparse freckles, calm expression, black gothic layered outfit with opaque top, layered skirt, belts, metallic accessories, opaque tights, and black boots.
prompt.composition_elements: Full-body mirror reflection with phone in front of face, messy bedroom, anime/alternative posters, bright curtained window, cluttered desk, bookshelf with books and figures, carpet, chair, cables, and natural room detail.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft natural daylight through a window, neutral indoor shadows, raw everyday alternative fashion mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic smartphone mirror photography, portrait 4:5, full-body, sharp background details, natural skin and fabric texture.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Approved adult woman with copper-red wavy hair and light blue-grey eyes takes a full-body mirror selfie in a messy gothic bedroom, wearing a black layered outfit with opaque coverage, metallic accessories, opaque tights, and black boots. Show posters, window, desk clutter, bookshelf, chair, cables, carpet, and realistic daylight. No exposed lingerie or watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, bra-like top, fishnet tights, lingerie, transparent fabric, exposed underwear, sexualized pose, distorted reflection, extra fingers, unreadable personal text, watermark, logo invention, public figure likeness.
